title: pentanema indicum var. hypoleucum
intro: Pentanema indicum var. hypoleucum, commonly known as Himalayan pentanema, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include reducing fever, treating respiratory infections, and alleviating gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of Himalayan pentanema include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
